newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African GDP hit by agriculture slowdown.
newsitem.headline: S.African GDP hit by agriculture slowdown.

text.p: The fall in South African gross domestic product (GDP) in the first quarter of 1997 was mainly due to a sharp decline in agricultural production, the Central Statistical Service said on Thursday.
Seasonally adjusted and annualised GDP fell 0.8 percent in the first quarter of 1997 after rising 3.3 percent at market prices in the fourth quarter of 1996.
But the negative growth -- the first since the first quarter of 1994 -- was mainly due to the decline of 34.1 percent in the annualised seasonally adjusted rate of real agricultural production.
Excluding agriculture, non-agricultural GDP recorded a positive growth rate of 1.4 percent in the first quarter, the CSS said.
The sector contributing most to growth in the first quarter was manufacturing with a growth rate of 3.6 percent, up from 2.2 percent in the fourth quarter.
